name: theme-toggle
title: Theme toggle
description: Light or Dark in one small pill: the thumb slides under the mode you pick, its glyph turns upright and the other steps back. Sun and moon icons for a site header or a sidebar, the mode names for a settings row. It only reports the choice, so you apply the theme your way, before first paint, and keep it per device.
